checks.manualUI: school -> model publish -> inputs -> trial -> formal -> review -> report edit -> report review -> preview -> PDF

findings.description: RULE_CONFIG with missing schema fields can be published; accounting choices then silently filter it out.
Activity unit is free text; an unsupported Chinese unit is accepted on draft save and later diagnosed with an internal lines.0.value path.
Invalid or cross-school accounting detail pages return HTTP 500 rather than 404; APIs correctly reject access.
25 operating years produce 305 input controls and a 13664px page without batch import or persistent save controls.
Line results show UUID and normalized quantity without item name or unit; snapshot link opens raw JSON.
Accounting list lacks search/status filters and exposes raw English status values.
Public report template versions are not connected to report generation; built-in versioned template is used.
390px accounting viewport has 414px body width and horizontal page overflow.
Long cover title leaves a single final Chinese character on its own line.

limits: Synthetic acceptance does not replace formal business signoff B01-B06.
Performance/load, backup restore and production deployment were not executed.
Only current PV GRID_ONLY scope; Word and other generation technologies are later scopes.
